name: view-0
source:
---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLES x, y
vars == <<x, y>>
Init == x = 0 /\ y \in {0,1}
A == x < 2 /\ x' = x + 1 /\ y' = (y + 1) % 2
B == x' = x /\ y' = (y + 1) % 2
Next == A \/ B
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(A) /\ WF_vars(B)
View == x % 2
Inv == x <= 2 /\ y \in {0, 1}
Prop == <> (x = 2)
====
config: INIT Init NEXT Next VIEW View CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
